title: Working Parents Struggle with Blurred Work Family Boundaries
discussion_signal: The post relays that 70% of working parents handle parenting tasks while working, 59% handle work tasks while with children, and 54% find balancing responsibilities difficult. Comments add lived examples: banking sick hours for a child's recurring illness, orchestrating rather than balancing work and family, and lacking nearby family help. The signal is that care is absorbed through work interruption, leave rationing, and coordination labor.
linked_research_question: How does care availability become time poverty, work substitution, and household coordination cost for U.S. families?
limits: The post is a research relay and comments are self-selected
The figures do not identify employer-level productivity or income effects
Comments do not establish prevalence beyond the commenters
